hotel_name: Zone Connect By The Park Saket New Delhi

positive_snippets: Good spread in breakfast. Good prompt and helpful service from the staff during breakfast. Specifically Mr Satya is very proactive polite and motivated. My suggestion is to increase the menu of continental dishes during breakfast. Right now the menu has more variety of Indian dishes. To balance it out some continental dishes will be good. House keeping is also good maintaining cleanliness. Special mention for Tinku ji who is dilligent in cleaning rooms

I had an excellent stay at this hotel. The rooms were spotless, spacious, and very comfortable. The staff was incredibly polite, professional, and always ready to help with a smile. The location is perfect-close to key attractions yet peaceful and relaxing. The food was delicious, with plenty of variety to choose from. What impressed me most was the attention to detail and the warm hospitality that made me feel truly at home. Highly recommended for anyone looking for comfort, cleanliness, and great service. I will definitely be coming back.

My stay at Zone Connect has been very comfortable. The Housekeeping staff kept my room clean everyday refilling stock regularly. Likewise the restaurant staff were also very helpful including Satya who prepared bread omlet on request at their live counter. The front office staff were also very prompt at servicing the customers. Overall experience: very comfortable. Thank you.
negative_snippets: We made a luxe room prepaid booking with the hotel. They gave us base category room  instead and lied that it is the luxe room. We told them multiple times but they said it is luxe. Later ant the time of check out when the bill was generated it showed based category room. They kept on saying there is not much difference in the rooms when we said they cheated us. Basically untrustworthy and poor intentions. Also, they did not refund us the difference amount.

I recently stayed at this hotel during an Italian fam trip, and unfortunately, the experience was very disappointing.

This hotel is definitely not worth the price and does not meet 4-star standards. In my opinion, it should be rated as a budget hotel. The rooms are very old, poorly maintained, and not clean. There was visible dust in all the rooms, and the bathrooms had many stains and signs of neglect. The entire property is in urgent need of renovation.

As a travel agent, I would not recommend this hotel, especially for international clients, as it does not meet the level of comfort and quality expected.

Overall, very disappointing experience.
